description: This file contains internal implementation code for progress reporting in the Ginkgo testing framework, including goroutine extraction, signal registration, and progress report creation.

classes.name: ProgressStepCursor
classes.description: Represents a cursor in a progress report with text, code location, and start time.

methods.name: RegisterForProgressSignal
methods.description: Registers a signal handler for progress signals and returns a cancel function.

methods.name: NewProgressReport
methods.description: Creates a new progress report with current state, goroutines, and relevant context.

methods.name: extractRunningGoroutines
methods.description: Extracts current running goroutines and their stack traces.

methods.name: fetchSource
methods.description: Fetches source code lines around a specific line number from a file, with caching.
